welcome_subtitle: Print large maps, posters, game boards, and engineering drawings from PDF or image files.

home_help: Choose a task below. The app will set the main options for that workflow.
merge_pdfs_desc: Combine full pages from multiple PDFs/images into one PDF.
extract_pages_desc: Use full pages and export only the pages you choose.
make_poster_desc: Tile a map, poster, image, or drawing across A4/US Letter sheets.
rotate_pages_desc: Rotate pages in preview and save the rotated result as a new PDF.
selected_area_pdf_desc: Select part of a PDF/image and export only that area.
source_pdfs_help: Thumbnails show source pages. Double-click an item to review the exact selected area.
output_area_help:
Whole Page does not require area selection.
Selected Area uses the area you select in the preview.
output_files_help:
One PDF combines selected pages into one file.
Separate creates one PDF for each selected page.
single_page_help:
Used only for Single Page Mode.
Exports the selected area as clean single-page output.
preview_controls_tooltip: Show or hide preview view controls
reset_view_tooltip: Reset View: Fit Page, Zoom, and Rotation
auto_select_disabled_tip: Disabled because Output Area is Whole Page. Choose Selected Area to use Auto Select.
auto_select_current_tip: Automatically detect the content area on the current page.
auto_select_all_tip: Automatically detect content areas on all pages.
auto_select_range_tip: Automatically detect content areas for a specific page range.
open_one_file_best:
Open One File is best for a single map, poster, image, or drawing.

Use Current Source PDFs keeps the files already loaded in Source PDFs.
poster_area_help:
Whole Page uses the full page or image.

Selected Area uses only the area you select in the preview.
poster_whole_page_set:
Output Area set to Whole Page.

Choose Poster Size Preset, check Tiling Preview, then click Poster PDF in the toolbar.
poster_selected_area_set:
Output Area set to Selected Area.

Drag to select an area or use Auto Select, then Build Print Order and click Poster PDF.
click_create_single_page_pdf_merge: Click Create Single Page PDF to create the merged PDF.
click_create_single_page_pdf_extract:
Click Create Single Page PDF to export each selected page as a separate PDF.

If you want one combined PDF instead, change Output Files to One PDF.
enter_page_range_extract:
Enter page range to extract from each source file:
Examples: all, 1-10, 1,3,5, 10-20,35
enter_page_range_auto_select:
Enter page range to auto select:
Examples: all, 1-50, 1,3,5, 10-20,35
